description: Read the SUITE-LEVEL test-data iterations of suite `suiteId` (SU-24) in an environment. Suite-level test data is a SEPARATE store from the member test cases' own test data. When the user says "SU-24 test data", ALWAYS use this — never tc_get_testdata on a member test case. `environmentType` is REQUIRED: call tc_list_environments, show the keys, and ASK which env. The result lists every iteration (name, default marker, parameter=value cells).

environmentType.description: Environment key from tc_list_environments (e.g. general, general_1).

name: suite_get_testdata
title: Read a suite's SUITE-LEVEL test data
